description.en: Structural code intelligence for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — gives the agent codegraph and codegraph_index tools to find where a symbol is declared, what calls it, and what a change   reaches, from a tree-sitter index it builds itself. Compatible with the codegraph CLI's on-disk format.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代码结构分析工具，快速定位符号声明、调用关系及变更影响范围。

description.en: Tool-call & think-summary translation with dual AI (OpenAI-compatible) + Bing channels for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
Agent 行为守护桌宠：跨 agent 监控可疑外传（加密打包直传对象存储 / DNS 外泄线索 / 敏感密钥被读），发现即告警，明确确认后按「一次一个」终止目标 agent；事件写入只追加 guard-events.jsonl，并通过 DSH host 工具 + MCP(stdio) 供其它 agent 查询
MasterGo Canvas MCP bundle with a managed local sidecar for DeepSeek Harness
Archived-conversation manager for DeepSeek Harness: search, browse, unarchive, and delete archived conversations in Settings → 已归档.
DSH plugin: auto-detect and configure model capabilities (reasoningEfforts + input modalities) for llm-pi-ai. Successor to dsh-reasoning-efforts.
Consistency guard for long-form writing: scans conversation prose for character, timeline and numeric setting conflicts across chapters, then jumps straight to the conflicting message.
description.zh: 长文创作一致性守卫：扫描会话正文，发现人物年龄、等级、境界、年份等设定跨章节矛盾，点击直接跳转到冲突原文位置。

description.en: Turn the tab icon into a green/amber status light and send browser notifications when a session finishes or awaits your input, with 47 selectable notification sounds.
description.zh: 把标签页图标变成绿/琥珀状态灯，并在会话跑完或有交互待处理时发送浏览器通知，含 47 个可选音效。

description.en: Ren'Py galgame production workbench: a host-side project service (write gateway plus git snapshots, a dialogue/scene dialect parser, derived progress, human-only review stamps, pinned-SDK validation and playtest, local publish) behind one seam, driven by an embedded web panel and agent tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里制作 Ren'Py galgame 的工作台：宿主侧项目服务（写网关 + git 快照、方言子集解析器、推导进度、只由人盖的审读戳、钉版 SDK 校验与试玩、本地发布）收在一条接缝后面，由内置 Web 工作台面板与 agent 工具驱动。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness skill plugin that reviews law theses (international economic law and other legal topics): reads a student Word .docx, checks it against a bundled common-issue checklist, applies definite fixes as tracked changes, and adds Word comments for overall/section problems and missing-basis issues, then emits a short objective overall review plus a fix list.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能插件：批改法学论文（国际经济法等）。读取学生 Word 论文，对照打包的常见问题清单逐项检查；可直接确定的错漏以 Word 修订模式修改，对部分整体问题、缺依据/缺澄清之处写 Word 批注；并输出简短、客观、以宏观点评为主的总体评语与待修改清单。

description.en: Share a selected chat segment as Markdown, HTML, TXT, or PNG; Session-header dialog with range or multi-select, redaction, tool calls, and subagent conversations, plus the /share command.
description.zh: 将选中的聊天片段分享为 Markdown、HTML、TXT 或 PNG；提供 Session Header 弹窗（范围或多选、脱敏、工具调用、子代理对话）与 /share 命令。
